title: If You Know These 5 Words, Your English Is Advanced (Part 5) #shorts
description:
If you know these 5 words, your English is advanced:
• Serene: calm and peaceful
• Cunning: clever at tricking people
• Gloomy: dark and sad
• Humble: not proud
• Notorious: famous for something bad

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
